name: lyssom-pi-caduceus
description: Pi extension: persona-aware Spec-Driven Development lifecycle harness. 10 built-in personas, 5-MD-file SDD (explore/propose/apply/archive), 6-state review machine, 5 static-analysis lenses (P0–P3). 0 deps, 0 native, 0 postinstall. ~7 kLOC pure TS, MIT.
